title: A theme's truth ledger
description: One entry per claim our profile (gdl/designsys/<theme>.json) or its generated README made that the template's own pages contradict, and how it is resolved. gdl/designsys/audit.py loads it and checks it against this schema with the subset of JSON Schema it implements (type, required, properties, additionalProperties, enum, items, minItems, minLength, pattern); `python -m gdl.designsys audit <theme>` reports what is unresolved.

claim.description: What our profile or README said.

where.description: Where it was: a profile key (dotted, a list item by its index or its name) or a README section ('README Layout', 'Page README').

template.description: What the template does, with the seed and the pages it was read off.

fix.description: Where the profile or README now says what the template does. Required for `fixed`; checked on any status that names one.

frame.description: What the region frame draws it from. Required for `frame`.

reason.description: Why we differ: a gate, or a capability the panel or the system lacks. Required for `deviation`.

here.description: What the system does instead, in the designer's words: the README's Differences says it. Required for `deviation`.

gone.description: Words of the old claim that must no longer appear in the profile or the README.

builds.description: What the fix changes in what builds, where it does.

key.description: A profile key, dotted; a list item by its index or its `name`.

readme.description: Words the generated README or a component's README holds.

series.description: The `panels` series whose frame holds it; any series' when absent.

key.description: A key in the frame, dotted.
